1500 DS Spirits Vol. 5 - Hanafuda.name: 1500 DS Spirits Vol. 5: Hanafuda
1500 DS Spirits Vol. 5 - Hanafuda.summary: 1500DS Spirits Vol. 5: Hanafuda is a Japanese Hanafuda game for the Nintendo DS.

Battle of Giants - Mutant Insects.name: Battle of Giants: Mutant Insects
Battle of Giants - Mutant Insects.summary: In a far distant future, a gigantic asteroid went out of orbit and collided with Earth. This terrible catastrophe left only ruins in its wake, forever changing Earths landscape and its inhabitants. Insects, the most adaptable form of life on Earth, have mutated to transform into massive giants and become the new rulers of the planet.

Biker Mice from Mars.name: Biker Mice From Mars
Biker Mice from Mars.summary: The Biker Mice from Mars are on a quest to get hold of the one thing that can save Mars, their home planet, from total destruction – the Regenerator, but they are not the only ones who want this powerful item – Hairball, leader of the ruthless feline race "the Catatonians", and Ronald Rump, evil corporate land developer want the Regenerator for their own evil purposes. They will throw everything they have at our heroes to acquire it, but the Biker Mice are not alone – they have friends throughout the solar system to help them when the going gets rough. It's an action-packed struggle that starts on Earth and culminates on the planet Mars, with the fate of both planets hanging in the balance! Play the role of each of the three popular Biker Mice: Throttle, the cool leader, Vinnie, the fun dare-devil, or Modo the gentle giant. Throughout each challenge, General Carbine is in touch with the Biker Mice to communicate the mission objectives. Charley the mechanic will also help by repairing their bikes, inventing new weapons and gadgets, and instructing the heroes on how to use them.

Doodle Hex.name: Doodle Hex
Doodle Hex.summary: Doodle Hex is a puzzle fighting game utilising touch screen gestures to cast spells.

DS Dengeki Bunko - Iriya no Sora, UFO no.name: DS Dengeki Bunko: Iriya no Sora, UFO no Natsu
DS Dengeki Bunko - Iriya no Sora, UFO no.summary: DS Dengeki Bunko: Iriya no Sora, UFO no Natsu is a visual novel based on the Japanese sci-fi light novel series Iriya no Sora, UFO no Natsu.

Makai Senki Disgaea - Makai no Ouji to A.name: Disgaea DS
Makai Senki Disgaea - Makai no Ouji to A.summary: Players will initially take on the role of Overlord Laharl, a young demon prince who has just woken from a two-year long nap and finds out that his father, who was the king, has passed away. In order to regain his rightful title as King of the Netherworld, Laharl sets off on a demonic adventure, but must do so with a back stabbing servant, love stupid angel, and a few disgruntled penguins who are looking for trouble.

Nounenrei - Nou Stress Kei Atama Scan.name: Mind Quiz: Your Brain Coach
Nounenrei - Nou Stress Kei Atama Scan.summary: In Mind Quiz, you'll participate in 49 exercises that strengthen your brain muscles. Practice lessons and learning games will make you smarter as you build your abilities in calculation, reflex, judgement and memory.
